take_homes: Seats activated is not adoption. I should ask for usage by person and by task, not licence counts.
Before approving a shared tool, ask who answers for it when it is wrong. The tool can be copied but the owner can't.
Test a new tool against what people use today. Talk to one person first, before spending anything.

monday.move: Ask my controller how she writes the month-end variance commentary today, step by step. Then ask what would have to be true for her to let an agent draft it.
monday.when: Monday, 15 minutes after the finance meeting
monday.stop_condition: If she says the current process takes under an hour or she doesn't trust a draft, I drop it. I do not ask for budget.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data, so there is no test until they do.

misconception.why: I buy licences and read the activation report as success. The slide says access and uptake are different numbers. I'm still not convinced the organisation builds the capability, because nobody gave me a cost or payback figure.

one_line: Good on why rollouts stall, and it names the accountability gap. But the exercises assume I already run agents, and I didn't see a number once.
